new.title: Perfect matching on a 3 by 3 graph: some normal-form circuit of at most 11 gates opens with NOT of wire 0, then NOT of wire 1
new.statement:
∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 11 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 4 && x 8) || (x 0 && x 5 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 3 && x 8) || (x 1 && x 5 && x 6) || (x 2 && x 3 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 4 && x 6))) ∧
    C.output + 1 = 9 + C.size ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧
          ∃ a, a < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a]) ∨
      (((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
          (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
          ∃ a b, a < b ∧ b < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b])) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      (∃ x y : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn y)).getD (9 + j.val) false) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 9 + j.val → ∃ x : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD k false) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, j.val + 1 < C.gates.length →
      ∃ k : Fin C.gates.length, j.val < k.val ∧ 9 + j.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs) ∧
    C.gates.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, [0]⟩ ∧
    C.gates.tail.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, [1]⟩
new.unlocks: One case of the cut of 3 by 3 perfect matching at 11 gates by its two earliest gates: with the other cases under the same earliest gate and their cover, the floor for that earliest gate, one of five the assembly takes.
new.sketch: The two earliest gates are written out and the circuit is in normal form: output last, operands increasing, no constant or repeated wire, every gate but the last listed later. For the no side these are hypotheses: split on the third gate, or write the normal-form gate lists of at most 11 gates with these two gates as clauses and replay a solver certificate inside Lean (the checker takes no native_decide). For the some side: one explicit gate list, each clause by decide over the 512 inputs. Too large for one file? Hand it back and it is cut again by its next gate.

∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 11 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 4 && x 8) || (x 0 && x 5 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 3 && x 8) || (x 1 && x 5 && x 6) || (x 2 && x 3 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 4 && x 6))) ∧
    C.output + 1 = 9 + C.size ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧
          ∃ a, a < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a]) ∨
      (((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
          (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
          ∃ a b, a < b ∧ b < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b])) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      (∃ x y : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn y)).getD (9 + j.val) false) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 9 + j.val → ∃ x : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD k false) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, j.val + 1 < C.gates.length →
      ∃ k : Fin C.gates.length, j.val < k.val ∧ 9 + j.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs) ∧
    C.gates.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [0, 1]⟩ ∧
    C.gates.tail.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [3, 8]⟩
new.unlocks: One case of the cut of 3 by 3 perfect matching at 11 gates by its two earliest gates: with the other cases under the same earliest gate and their cover, the floor for that earliest gate, one of five the assembly takes.
new.sketch: The two earliest gates are written out and the circuit is in normal form: output last, operands increasing, no constant or repeated wire, every gate but the last listed later. For the no side these are hypotheses: split on the third gate, or write the normal-form gate lists of at most 11 gates with these two gates as clauses and replay a solver certificate inside Lean (the checker takes no native_decide). For the some side: one explicit gate list, each clause by decide over the 512 inputs. Too large for one file? Hand it back and it is cut again by its next gate.

∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 12 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 4 && x 8) || (x 0 && x 5 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 3 && x 8) || (x 1 && x 5 && x 6) || (x 2 && x 3 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 4 && x 6))) ∧
    C.output + 1 = 9 + C.size ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧
          ∃ a, a < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a]) ∨
      (((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
          (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
          ∃ a b, a < b ∧ b < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b])) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      (∃ x y : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn y)).getD (9 + j.val) false) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 9 + j.val → ∃ x : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD k false) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, j.val + 1 < C.gates.length →
      ∃ k : Fin C.gates.length, j.val < k.val ∧ 9 + j.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs) ∧
    C.gates.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [0, 4]⟩ ∧
    C.gates.tail.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [1, 2]⟩
new.unlocks: One case of the cut of 3 by 3 perfect matching at 12 gates by its two earliest gates: with the other cases under the same earliest gate and their cover, the floor for that earliest gate, one of five the assembly takes.
new.sketch: The two earliest gates are written out and the circuit is in normal form: output last, operands increasing, no constant or repeated wire, every gate but the last listed later. For the no side these are hypotheses: split on the third gate, or write the normal-form gate lists of at most 12 gates with these two gates as clauses and replay a solver certificate inside Lean (the checker takes no native_decide). For the some side: one explicit gate list, each clause by decide over the 512 inputs. Too large for one file? Hand it back and it is cut again by its next gate.

¬ (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 11 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 4 && x 8) || (x 0 && x 5 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 3 && x 8) || (x 1 && x 5 && x 6) || (x 2 && x 3 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 4 && x 6))) ∧
    C.output + 1 = 9 + C.size ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧
          ∃ a, a < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a]) ∨
      (((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
          (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
          ∃ a b, a < b ∧ b < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b])) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      (∃ x y : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn y)).getD (9 + j.val) false) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 9 + j.val → ∃ x : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD k false) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, j.val + 1 < C.gates.length →
      ∃ k : Fin C.gates.length, j.val < k.val ∧ 9 + j.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs) ∧
    C.gates.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [0, 4]⟩ ∧
    C.gates.tail.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [2, 6]⟩)
new.sketch: A proof is one explicit counterexample to the positive statement L-meta-27730; none is expected if that statement is true.

new.title: Representative sections detect contradictions and count surviving clauses under arbitrary private Boolean substitution
new.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < w i) →
  ∀ g : (i : Fin n) → (Fin (w i) → Bool) → Bool, (∀ i b, ∃ x, g i x = b) →
  let B := PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)
  let Raw := (i : Fin n) × Fin (w i)
  let Axiom := PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw
  let Tape := (i : Fin n) → Bool → Fin (w i) → Bool
  let sections := (Finset.univ : Finset Tape).filter (fun s => ∀ i b, g i (s i b) = b)
  let block := fun (C : B) (x : Raw → Bool) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset Raw).filter (fun j => j.1 ∈ C.image Prod.fst)).image (fun j => (j, !(x j)))
  let copies := fun (C : B) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Raw → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      ∀ l ∈ C, g l.1 (fun j => x ⟨l.1,j⟩) ≠ l.2)).image (block C)
  ∀ F : Finset B, (∀ C ∈ F, ∀ i, ¬ ((i,true) ∈ C ∧ (i,false) ∈ C)) →
    let allAx := F.biUnion copies
    let project := fun (A : Finset Axiom) (s : Tape) => F.filter (fun C =>
      block C (fun z => s z.1 (decide ((z.1,false) ∈ C)) z.2) ∈ A)
    let bad := fun {V : Type} (K : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) =>
      ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (K : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V))
    ∀ A : Finset Axiom, A ⊆ allAx →
      (bad A ↔ ∀ s ∈ sections, bad (project A s)) ∧
      ∀ C ∈ F, (copies C).card * (sections.filter (fun s => C ∈ project A s)).card =
        sections.card * (A ∩ copies C).card
new.unlocks: Detects inconsistent selections of raw clauses and counts their surviving source clauses under representative sections.
new.context: Every raw assignment belongs to a section: prescribe its word at the observed output, and choose an arbitrary preimage at the other output. On a section each surviving blocker falsifies exactly its original clause. For a given clause its falsifying values select one representative slot per variable. Fixing words in those slots chooses a single raw blocker. All choices have the same number of completions to a section, even for unequal fiber sizes.

new.title: Parity cuts that meet every subspace on which a binary alternating pencil loses dimension
new.statement:
∀ (n s p : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let V := Fin n → F
  let Dual := V →ₗ[F] F
  let Form := V →ₗ[F] Dual
  ∀ B : Fin s → Form, LinearIndependent F B → (∀ i x, B i x x = 0) →
    let mix := fun c : Fin s → F => ∑ i : Fin s, c i • B i
    let rk := fun c : Fin s → F => Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range (mix c))
    let small := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s → F)).filter (fun c => c ≠ 0 ∧ rk c ≤ 2*p)
    let shrinks := fun D : Submodule F V =>
      let row := fun i : Fin s => fun z : D × D => B i z.1.val z.2.val
      Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range row)) < s
    let admissible := fun D : Submodule F V => n - Module.finrank F D ≤ p ∧ shrinks D
    ((∃ D : Submodule F V, admissible D) ↔ small.Nonempty) ∧
      (∃ cuts : Finset Dual, (0 : Dual) ∉ cuts ∧
        cuts.card ≤ ∑ c ∈ small, ((2 : Nat)^(rk c/2+1)-1) ∧
        (∀ l ∈ cuts, ∃ c ∈ small, l ∈ LinearMap.range (mix c)) ∧
        (∀ D : Submodule F V, admissible D → ∃ l ∈ cuts, ∀ x ∈ D, l x = 0))
new.unlocks: Produces parity candidates covering every feasible rank reduction while searching for a key-counting circuit.
new.context: A drop makes a nonzero combination vanish on D times D. Modulo its radical a rank-2a form is symplectic. The image of D is isotropic, of dimension at most a, so a is at most p. Conversely lift a Lagrangian for any qualifying combination. In its 2a-dimensional dual image choose a fixed (a+1)-space. At least a dimensions of the image vanish on any qualifying D for that combination. The two spaces intersect. Union the nonzero vectors of the chosen spaces. Estimated 120 minutes.

changed.title: Find a nineteen-leaf binary De Morgan formula for three binary relations with an indexed closed walk
changed.statement:
let addr := fun (r a b : ℕ) => (Fin.ofNat 12 (4 * r + a + 2 * b))
let accepts := fun (x : Fin 12 → Bool) =>
    ∃ s t u : Fin 2, x (addr 0 s.val t.val) = true ∧
      x (addr 1 t.val u.val) = true ∧ x (addr 2 u.val s.val) = true
∃ F : PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula 12, F.leaves ≤ 19 ∧
    ∀ x, F.eval x = true ↔ accepts x
changed.unlocks: tests whether the twenty-leaf three-relation formula can be shortened
changed.context: We hold a twenty-leaf formula, with no witness at nineteen leaves. It groups by states s,t. For fixed s, the two t groups both use the literal C(0,s) and both use C(1,s), the two return edges. Try regrouping these occurrences by return state, or factoring only one return edge across the two groups. Each repeated literal still costs a leaf. Test all 4,096 tables on the same twelve independent entries, allowing signed literals.

changed.title: Find a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit under the ranked cyclic witness negation bound
changed.statement:
∃ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (q : Fin (2 ^ n)),
  let I := n * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (outBit : Fin n → Fin (I + C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧
    (∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let inputs := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => List.ofFn (fun pat : Fin (2 ^ (w + 1)) =>
        table i (fun j => pat.val.testBit j.val)))).flatten
      let sols := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ n))).filter (fun z => ∀ i : Fin n,
        table i (fun j => z.val.testBit (n - 1 - ((i.val + j.val) % n))) = true)
      q.val < sols.card → ∃ z ∈ sols,
        (sols.filter (fun y => y.val < z.val)).card = q.val ∧
        ∀ pos : Fin n, (C.wires inputs).getD (outBit pos).val false =
          z.val.testBit (n - 1 - pos.val)) ∧
    ∃ k b : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ w + 1 ∧ k + b ≤ n ∧ q.val < 2 ^ (k + b) ∧
      2 ^ PEqualNP.NotBracket.notCount C <
        1 + ((n - b) / k) * (2 ^ k - 1) - q.val / 2 ^ b
changed.unlocks: tests the ranked-word NOT bound on all valid cyclic tables
changed.context: We hold no circuit below this bound. Test the free-tail charge with n=5, w=1, k=2, b=1 and q=3. The chain predicts that two NOT gates cannot suffice. Shared negations may serve output bits across blocks, but each valid rank must be returned on the same fixed wires on every raw table. Give a gate list and count each internal NOT once.

changed.title: Find a two-NOT circuit for the fourth cyclic three-bit solution within the three-NOT gate budget
changed.statement:
∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (outBit : Fin 3 → Fin (12 + C.size)),
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack 12 C ∧
  C.size ≤ 46 ∧ PEqualNP.NotBracket.notCount C ≤ 2 ∧
  ∀ table : Fin 3 → Bool → Bool → Bool,
    let inputs := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 3 =>
      [table i false false, table i true false, table i false true, table i true true])).flatten
    let sols := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 8)).filter (fun z => ∀ i : Fin 3,
      table i (z.val.testBit (2 - i.val)) (z.val.testBit (2 - ((i.val + 1) % 3))) = true)
    3 < sols.card → ∃ z ∈ sols, (sols.filter (fun y => y.val < z.val)).card = 3 ∧
      ∀ pos : Fin 3, (C.wires inputs).getD (outBit pos).val false = z.val.testBit (2 - pos.val)
changed.unlocks: tests whether the fourth cyclic solution can be returned with two NOTs within the held gate budget
changed.context: We hold a 46-gate circuit with three NOTs, and no two-NOT witness within that budget. Its H(t) tests whether labels zero through t include four viable words. The output bits use separate negations of tests involving H(3), H(4), H(5) and H(6). Try sharing a negation across the two low-bit tests using the restrictions on viable labels imposed by three pair relations. Verify all 4,096 tables, constraining the output precisely when the rank exists.

changed.title: Find a binary De Morgan formula below the parity-lane leaf bound for full cyclic window tables
changed.statement:
∃ d extra a q : ℕ,
  let k := d + 1
  let w := k + extra
  let m := a + 1
  let n := m * k + q * (k + 1)
  let hn : 0 < n := Nat.add_pos_left (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos a) (Nat.succ_pos d)) _
  let stride := 2 ^ (w + 1)
  let I := n * stride
  ∃ F : PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula I,
    (∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let inputs := fun addr : Fin I =>
        table ⟨(addr.val / stride) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ (fun bit => addr.val.testBit bit.val)
      F.eval inputs = true ↔ ∃ word : Fin n → Bool, ∀ i : Fin n,
        table i (fun k => word ⟨(i.val + k.val) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩) = true) ∧
    F.leaves < 2 ^ d * m ^ 2
changed.unlocks: tests the proposed leaf floor for full cyclic window table decision formulas
changed.context: We hold no formula below the proposed bound. Try k=2, m=10, q=0 and w=2, where the target is fewer than 200 leaves on 160 raw bits. The alternating tag restrictions in the parity argument charge disjoint sets of occurrences. Test whether a signed-literal tree can reuse a factor across tags without changing the answer on tables outside those restrictions. Count each occurrence and verify the universal cyclic-word test on the full table.

changed.title: Sixteen scheduled columns obstruct every shift-12 mate lookup on the four-round 17-bit row zero
changed.statement:
let k : Nat := 17
let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
  ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
  (List.range k).foldl (fun acc b =>
    acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit b)
      (!(word.testBit ((b + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((b + 2) % k))).toNat <<< b)) 0
let output := fun (w : Nat) =>
  ((List.range 4).foldl (fun x t =>
    step (x ^^^ rot 1 x ^^^ rot (k - 1) x) ^^^ rot (2 * t) w ^^^
      (3 ^ (k + (t + 1)) % 2 ^ k)) (rot 1 w)) >>> 8
let columnPass := fun (key name : Nat) =>
  ((List.range 4).foldl (fun state j =>
    step (state ^^^ rot 2 state ^^^ rot (k - 2) state) ^^^
      rot (3 * (j + 1) + 1) key ^^^ (3 ^ (k + (4 + (j + 1))) % 2 ^ k))
    (rot 3 key ^^^ name)) < 2 ^ 8
let keys := List.range (2 ^ k)
∀ lookup : Nat → Bool, ∃ column : Fin (2 ^ k),
  column.val ∈ ([0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 18, 22, 26, 29] : List Nat) ∧
  ¬ ((∃ w ∈ keys, output w = 0 ∧ columnPass w column.val) ↔
    (∃ candidate ∈ keys,
      (if candidate.testBit 2 then output candidate = 0
       else lookup (output (candidate ^^^ 12)) = true) ∧ columnPass candidate column.val))

Read coversNames by induction on the nine remaining planes. If the lookup accepts an available name at 0, that name also accepts a negative column. If it accepts none, there is no direct probed witness and column 0 is wrongly rejected.

changed.title: One batch of linear images certifies exact recovery of dense hidden binary constraints with a short random seed
changed.statement:
∀ (n s : ℕ), 3 ≤ s → s ≤ n →
  let W := Fin n → Bool
  let Lit := Fin n × Bool
  let F := Finset (Lit × Lit)
  let sat := fun (C : F) (w : W) => decide (∀ c ∈ C,
    w c.1.1 ≠ c.1.2 ∨ w c.2.1 ≠ c.2.2)
  let high := fun (C : F) =>
    2 ^ n * (2 ^ (s - 1) + 1) ≤
      2 ^ s * (Finset.univ.filter (fun word => sat C word = true)).card
  let L := Nat.clog 2 (n + 1)
  let a := 16 * (1 + 4 * (1 + L))
  let T := 8 + Nat.clog 2 (n - s + 1)
  let M := 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 (4 + (s + 4) * (1 + L))
  let V := Fin (s + 2) → Bool
  ∃ (cal : Fin a → W) (row : Fin M → Fin T → Fin n → V)
    (report : Fin M → (Fin a → Bool) → (Fin T → V → Bool) → Option F),
    ∀ C : F,
      let result := fun seed : Fin M =>
        report seed (fun slot => sat C (cal slot)) (fun block input => sat C (fun bit =>
          (∑ l : Fin (s + 2), ((row seed block bit l) && input l).toNat) % 2 == 1))
      (∀ trial B, result trial = some B → high C ∧ ∀ z, sat B z = sat C z) ∧
      (high C → 3 * M ≤ 4 * (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun u : Fin M => (result u).isSome = true)).card)
changed.unlocks: bounds the queries and random seed needed for certified recovery of dense hidden binary constraints in one fixed batch
changed.context: Calibrate the literal half with a strength-four pool. On its other side retain the coordinates constant on positive examples. Certify each retained bit by a negative matching all the other retained bits. A random linear image surjective on the center and leaves supplies every such test together. Surjectivity also on a free bit exhibits both signs. Union bound over free bits and repeat independent images. Sample a short menu of batches and union bound over the signed stars and disjoint clause pairs above the cutoff. All reports retain their certificates.

changed.title: Positive accumulation points of 2-CNF densities are exactly half the attainable positive densities
changed.statement:
let W := fun width : ℕ => Fin width → Bool
let F := fun arity : ℕ => Finset ((Fin arity × Bool) × (Fin arity × Bool))
let sat := fun (len : ℕ) (A : F len) (x : W len) => decide (∀ c ∈ A,
  x c.1.1 ≠ c.1.2 ∨ x c.2.1 ≠ c.2.2)
let den := fun (size : ℕ) (G : F size) =>
  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun w : W size => sat size G w = true)).card : ℝ) / 2 ^ size
∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 →
  (∃ gap : ℝ, 0 < gap ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : F n), den n A < t → den n A ≤ t - gap) ∧
  ((∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : F n), t < den n A ∧ den n A < t + e) ↔
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (B : F d), den d B = 2 * t) ∧
  (∃ K : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : F n), t ≤ den n A →
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin n)) (B : F n),
      S.card ≤ K ∧ (∀ c ∈ B, c.1.1 ∈ S ∧ c.2.1 ∈ S) ∧
      t ≤ den n B ∧ ∀ z : W n, sat n B z = true → sat n A z = true)
changed.unlocks: Classifies the positive thresholds where hidden binary formulas can approach the cutoff from above.
changed.context: At density bounded away from zero a maximal disjoint clause packing gives a bounded vertex cover. Group other bits by their signed clauses into that cover. Along a subsequence each type multiplicity is fixed or tends to infinity. Given cover bits a growing type is free, forced or impossible. Only free types survive in the limit. Making them all free pins cover literals, yielding a bounded stronger formula of the limiting density. A nonempty growing type pins at least one bit. Remove one pin to double the limit. Conversely multiply by larger signed stars.

changed.title: Adaptive word queries for a hidden binary majority gap obey a seed-count tradeoff and pay a length cost for either one-sided error
changed.statement:
∀ (n s : ℕ), 3 ≤ s → s ≤ n →
  let W := Fin n → Bool
  let Lit := Fin n × Bool
  let F := Finset (Lit × Lit)
  let sat := fun (C : F) (w : W) => decide (∀ c ∈ C,
    w c.1.1 ≠ c.1.2 ∨ w c.2.1 ≠ c.2.2)
  let count := fun (G : F) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => sat G u = true)).card
  let Q := 2 ^ n
  ∀ (M q fp fn : ℕ), fp + fn < M →
    ∀ (ask : Fin M → List Bool → W) (report : Fin M → List Bool → Bool),
      let yes := fun (A : F) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun seed : Fin M =>
        let history := (List.range q).foldl (fun (past : List Bool) _ =>
          past ++ [sat A (ask seed past)]) []
        report seed history = true)).card
      (∀ A : F, 2 * count A ≤ Q → yes A ≤ fp) →
      (∀ A : F, Q * (2 ^ (s - 1) + 1) ≤ 2 ^ s * count A → M ≤ yes A + fn) →
      2 ^ (s - 1) * (M - fp - fn) ≤ q * (M - fp) ∧
      (fn = 0 → 2 ^ (s - 3) * Nat.clog 2 (2 * (n - s + 2) + 2) ≤ q) ∧
      (fp = 0 → 2 * n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ q)
changed.unlocks: bounds seed counts and query lengths for adaptive hidden majority decisions with either one-sided error
changed.context: Trace each seed on a unary half cube. A star adds one rare pattern on the center and s-1 leaves. Among R rejecting seeds, at least R-fn must hit each pattern on the baseline path, whereas each path hits at most q patterns. Sum and use R>=M-fp. With fn=0 one rejecting path covers every leaf pattern on every s-1 leaves. Slice by s-3 leaves, then count distinct signed columns and constants. With fp=0 take an accepting path on the full cube. A constant column or two equal or complementary columns give a unary or binary half-cube predicate with identical labels.

changed.title: A common normalized weighted list of signs approximates all nonnegative products of squared norms at the majority-size exponential rate
changed.statement:
∀ (q b p : ℕ), 2 ≤ q → 2 ≤ p →
  let K := (q : ℝ)/2 + if q % 2 = 0 then 1/2 else (q : ℝ)/(q+1)
  ∃ (t : ℕ) (signs : Fin t → Fin b → Fin q → Bool) (w : Fin t → ℝ),
    (∀ h, 0 ≤ w h) ∧ (∑ h : Fin t, w h) = 1 ∧
    (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 192*(p : ℝ)^2*K^b * (2+(b : ℝ)*q*Real.log (2+72*((b : ℝ)+1)*q)) ∧
    ∀ x : Fin b → Fin q → ℝ, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ x i j) →
      let target := ∏ i : Fin b, ∑ j : Fin q, (x i j)^2
      let est := ∑ h : Fin t, w h * ∏ i : Fin b,
        (∑ j : Fin q, (if signs h i j then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) * x i j)^2
      ((p : ℝ)-1)*target ≤ (p : ℝ)*est ∧ (p : ℝ)*est ≤ ((p : ℝ)+1)*target
changed.unlocks: constructs a single normalized sampling list with simultaneous accuracy for every nonnegative real weight vector
changed.context: Draw each sign vector from the minimizing isotropic law tilted by its majority size and use the inverse likelihood weight. On unit nonnegative vectors each weighted product has mean one and lies in [0,K^b]. At relative tolerance 1/(8p), Chernoff and a union bound cover all normalized grid tuples. The singleton test bounds total weight, so normalize the list. The grid error is then at most 1/(2p). Apply the norming-grid lemma to the estimator minus the norm product, and rescale nonunit vectors.

changed.title: Uniform relative accuracy on signed matrices and on zero-one boards forces exponential support for weighted determinant lists
changed.statement:
∀ (n p t : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → 2 ≤ p →
  let I := Fin n
  ∀ (signs : Fin t → I × I → Bool) (w : Fin t → ℝ), (∀ h, 0 ≤ w h) →
    let P := fun A : Matrix I I ℝ => Matrix.permanent (fun i j => (A i j)^2)
    let est := fun A : Matrix I I ℝ => ∑ h : Fin t, w h * (Matrix.det
      (fun i j => if signs h (i,j) then -A i j else A i j : Matrix I I ℝ))^2
    let good := fun A : Matrix I I ℝ =>
      ((p : ℝ)-1)*P A ≤ (p : ℝ)*est A ∧ (p : ℝ)*est A ≤ ((p : ℝ)+1)*P A
    let count := (Finset.univ.filter (fun h : Fin t => w h ≠ 0)).card
    let loss := (n+1)^(Nat.log2 n+1)
    let bpen := if n = 2^(Nat.log2 n) then 1 else loss
    ((∀ A : Matrix I I ℝ, good A) → (p-1)*n^n ≤ (p+1)*3*(n+1)*n.factorial*count) ∧
    ((∀ A : Matrix I I ℝ, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) → good A) →
      (p-1)*n^n ≤ (p+1)*2^n*3*(n+1)*n.factorial*count) ∧
    ((∀ A : Matrix I I ℝ, (∀ i j, A i j = -1 ∨ A i j = 0 ∨ A i j = 1) → good A) →
      (p-1)*n^n ≤ (p+1)*bpen*n.factorial*count) ∧
    ((∀ A : Matrix I I ℝ, (∀ i j, A i j = 0 ∨ A i j = 1) → good A) →
      (p-1)*n^n ≤ (p+1)*2^n*bpen*n.factorial*count)

For nonnegative or zero-one tests, row masking incurs a factor 2^n and preserves binary magnitudes. Sum the individual weight bounds over nonzero members.

changed.title: Conditional exact scan dimension for counting cyclic binary affine feedback solutions
changed.statement:
let affineRouting : Prop :=
  ∀ (b L : ℕ),
    let w := b + 1
    let V := Fin w → ZMod 2
    (∀ (g : V ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] V) (v : V),
      ∃ (tap : Fin L → Fin b → ZMod 2) (bias : Fin L → ZMod 2),
        ∀ x : V, (List.finRange L).foldl (fun (s : V) i =>
          let tail := fun j : Fin b => s j.succ
          Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin w => ZMod 2) tail
            (s 0 + bias i + ∑ j : Fin b, tap i j * tail j)) x = g x + v) ↔
      2 * w - 1 ≤ L
let fixedPointRank : Prop :=
  ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [CharP K 2] (b d : ℕ),
    let w := b + 1
    let V := Fin w → ZMod 2
    let P := (V ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] V) × V
    let fixed := fun (p r : P) =>
      ((Finset.univ : Finset V).filter (fun x => r.1 (p.1 x + p.2) + r.2 = x)).card
    (∃ (A B : P → Fin d → K),
      ∀ p r, (fixed p r : K) = ∑ j : Fin d, A p j * B r j) ↔
      Nat.choose (2 * w) w - 2 ≤ d
let conclusion : Prop :=
  ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [CharP K 2] (b a m : ℕ),
    let w := b + 1
    let n := a + 1
    let Control := (Fin b → ZMod 2) × ZMod 2
    let cost := Nat.choose (2 * w) w - 2
    let atSite := fun k => Fin.ofNat (a + 1) k
    let count := fun (C : Fin n → Control) =>
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → ZMod 2)).filter (fun x =>
        ∀ i : Fin n, x (atSite (i.val + w)) = x i + (C i).2 +
          ∑ j : Fin b, (C i).1 j * x (atSite (i.val + 1 + j.val)))).card
    let admits :=
      ∃ (s : Fin m → K) (step : Fin n → Control → (Fin m → K) →ₗ[K] (Fin m → K))
        (out : (Fin m → K) →ₗ[K] K),
        ∀ C : Fin n → Control,
          out ((List.finRange n).foldl (fun v i => step i (C i) v) s) = (count C : K)
    (cost ≤ m → admits) ∧ (2 * (2 * w - 1) ≤ n → admits → cost ≤ m)
affineRouting → fixedPointRank → conclusion
changed.unlocks: Allows the cyclic affine scan proof to proceed separately from routing and the rank calculation.
changed.context: Introduce the displayed hypotheses. Cyclic words correspond to fixed seeds, including repeated sites on short cycles. Track the products of the linear row maps on every proper nonzero exterior degree, starting from their identity matrices. Left multiplication is linear and the sum of traces gives parity for every bias. Cut after 2w-1 rows when the suffix is at least as long. Both control blocks realize every affine permutation independently, so prefix states and suffix functionals factor the full affine fixed-point matrix. Its rank forces the same dimension. Allow 120 to 240 minutes.

changed.title: Interior gates save at most half a gate apiece when decoding every choice of one literal per pair
changed.statement:
∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r →
  let I := Fin (2 * r)
  let names := fun (x : Fin (2 ^ r)) =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => Nat.testBit x.val (i.val / 2) = decide (i.val % 2 = 1))
  let supp := fun (E : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (w : ℕ) =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I =>
      (E.wires (List.ofFn (fun h : I => decide (h = i)))).getD w false = true)
  let realizes := fun (E : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    ∀ x : Fin (2 ^ r), ∃ w : ℕ, supp E w = names x
  ∀ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, realizes C →
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → g.inputs.length ≤ 2) →
    let price := fun (p : Fin C.gates.length) =>
      let S := supp C (2 * r + p.val)
      @ite ℕ ((C.gates.get p).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) 2 (if (∃ x, S ⊆ names x) then
        (if S.card = 2 then 2 else if 3 ≤ S.card then 3 else 0)
      else 0)
    ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, realizes D ∧
      (∀ g ∈ D.gates, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
      2 * D.size ≤ ∑ p, price p

changed.context: For each target cut its backward OR paths at other gates. Choose one outgoing edge per vertex and one source for each literal. Prune to a binary tree on disjoint leaf blocks. Complete each block of h literals by a binary tree, charging each branch 2^(leaf count). The cheapest full tree builds all targets by joining both subfamilies. An OR averages at most one over targets. A cut of support size t fits at most 2^(r-t) targets. Completion costs zero for h<=1, four for h=2 and at most 3*2^h/2 otherwise by splitting evenly after checking h=3,4,5. Double the average.

changed.title: One shared set of parity checks recovers the hidden payload on both sides of a cyclic intersection encoding
changed.statement:
∀ (a b h s q : Nat) (hn : 0 < a+b), 0 < q → 0 < s → s ≤ h →
  q*h < a → (q+1)*h ≤ b →
  let n := a+b
  let M := q^2 * (2^s-1)^(2*(q-1)) * 2^(n-(2*q*s+(h-s)))
  let Word := Fin n → Bool
  let Pat := Fin (n-h) → Bool
  let Slot := Fin n × Pat
  let loc := fun k : Nat => (⟨k % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let solutions := fun (tab : Slot → Bool) =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset Word).filter (fun x =>
      ∀ i : Fin n, tab (i,fun j => x (loc (i.val+j.val))) = true)
  ∃ (code : Fin M → Word) (base : Slot → Bool) (left right : Fin M → Slot),
    Function.Injective code ∧ Function.Injective left ∧ Function.Injective right ∧
    (∀ i, (left i).1.val < a ∧ a ≤ (right i).1.val ∧
      base (left i) = false ∧ base (right i) = false) ∧
    ∀ A B : Finset (Fin M), solutions (fun slot =>
      base slot || decide (slot ∈ A.image left) || decide (slot ∈ B.image right)) =
        (A ∩ B).image code

changed.unlocks: Gives every tail and moment of the number of compatible cyclic words at prescribed weight, including periodic and constant cases.
changed.context: On each one-run u is constant. Each zero beside a one is forced to zero, and each interior zero is free. changed.title: Cutting inversions gives an exact OR transposition test for one-hot encoder gate budgets
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (M : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (b s : ℕ),
  let hits := fun (p q : ℕ) (A : Fin p → Fin q → Bool)
      (E : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    ∀ y : Fin q, ∃ w : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin p,
      (E.wires (List.ofFn (fun h : Fin p => decide (h = x)))).getD w false = A x y
  let isOr := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
    g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2
  let isNot := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
    g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 1
  (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, hits n m M C ∧
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, isOr g ∨ isNot g) ∧ C.size ≤ s ∧
    C.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (isNot g) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ≤ b) ↔
  ∃ t : ℕ, t ≤ b ∧ ∃ (R : Fin (n+t) → Fin (m+t) → Bool) (z : Fin n → Fin t → Bool),
    (∀ i j : Fin t, j ≤ i → R (Fin.natAdd n i) (Fin.natAdd m j) = false) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin n) (j : Fin t), z x j =
      !(R (Fin.castAdd t x) (Fin.natAdd m j) ||
        decide (∃ i : Fin t, i < j ∧ z x i = true ∧ R (Fin.natAdd n i) (Fin.natAdd m j) = true))) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin n) (y : Fin m), M x y =
      (R (Fin.castAdd t x) (Fin.castAdd t y) ||
        decide (∃ i : Fin t, z x i = true ∧ R (Fin.natAdd n i) (Fin.castAdd t y) = true))) ∧
    ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
      hits (m+t) (n+t) (fun y x => R x y) D ∧ (∀ g ∈ D.gates, isOr g) ∧
      D.size + ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+t))).filter (fun u => ∃ v, R u v = true)).card + t ≤
        s + ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (m+t))).filter (fun v => ∃ u, R u v = true)).card
changed.unlocks: Reduces the cost of sharing negated name wires in an encoder to a binary OR decoder bound with explicit extra inputs and outputs.
changed.context: Cut each NOT in gate order into a source and an operand sink. OR reachability gives R. Substituting cut values in order restores M. Drop dead or zero wires, bypass copies, and add a sink per nonzero output. With g binary gates, u live inputs and v sinks there are 2g+v edges. Reversal costs the sum of fan-out minus one, or g+v-u ORs. Apply this in either direction. After reversing back, each forbidden entry means there is no path. Reconnecting the NOTs creates no cycle since cut indices would have to increase around it. Supply a zero sink by a missing wire.

changed.title: A small circuit exhibiting opposite changes on a three-input section
changed.statement:
∃ (n : Nat) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
  let W := Fin n → Bool
  let f := fun (x : W) => C.eval (List.ofFn x)
  let essential := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun j =>
    ∃ x : W, f (Function.update x j false) ≠ f (Function.update x j true))
  ∃ (a b c : Fin n) (x : W) (t : Bool), a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c ∧
    let atBits := fun (u v w : Bool) =>
      f (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update x a u) b v) c w)
    atBits true false false = t ∧ atBits false true true = t ∧
    atBits false true false = !t ∧ atBits false false true = !t ∧
    atBits true true false = !t ∧
    (∃ y : W, f (Function.update y c false) = t ∧ f (Function.update y c true) = !t) ∧
    C.size < essential.card + 2
changed.unlocks: Finds a counterexample to the proposed gate cost for opposite changes on a three-coordinate section.
changed.context: Search small fan-in-two circuits, compute their essential-input sets and enumerate restrictions to three coordinates. Keep a circuit only if the five prescribed section values and the opposite change are all verified. Supply its ordered gate list, input indices, assignment and essential count.

changed.title: Single input flips that change distinct sets of outputs force branching in a circuit
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (a : Fin n → Bool) (out : Fin m → ℕ),
  let value := fun (v : Fin n → Bool) (j : Fin m) =>
    (C.wires (List.ofFn v)).getD (out j) false
  let delta := fun i : Fin n => Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m =>
    value (fun h => if h = i then !(a h) else a h) j ≠ value a j)
  let moved := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (delta i).Nonempty)
  let wide := (Finset.univ.image delta).filter (fun s => 2 ≤ s.card)
  let ports := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m => ∃ i : Fin n, j ∈ delta i)
  let cost := fun p : Fin C.gates.length =>
    let g := C.gates.get p
    let used := @ite (List ℕ) (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)
      (Classical.propDecidable _) (g.inputs.take 1) g.inputs
    ((used.toFinset.filter (fun h => h < n + p.val)).card - 1)
  moved.card + wide.card ≤ ports.card + ∑ p, cost p
changed.unlocks: Turns distinct responses to single-bit flips into a gate lower bound for one-hot encoders even when unary gates are free.
changed.context: Keep the ancestors of the changing output ports, one sink per port. From a changed input follow the unique outgoing edge until a fork or sink. If two ports change, a fork occurs. Every path from that input to a sink passes through this fork. When two flips have the same fork, both toggle its one bit and give identical outputs, by evaluation with that wire fixed. Distinct wide change sets thus need distinct forks. Count edges at both ends: forks are at most live ports plus gate costs minus live raw inputs. Every changed input is live.

changed.title: Weight and complement weight characterize exact independence after pinning coordinates and fixing total parity
changed.statement:
∀ (k m d g : ℕ), d < k →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let V := Fin k → F
  ∀ v : Fin m → V,
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin m), 0 < S.card → S.card ≤ g →
      let w := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).filter (fun i => (∑ j ∈ S, v j i) = 1)).card
      d < w ∧ w+d < k) ↔
    ∀ (P : Finset (Fin k)), P.card ≤ d →
      ∀ (pins : V) (par : F) (S : Finset (Fin m)), S.card ≤ g → ∀ target : Fin m → F,
        2^(P.card+1+S.card) *
          ((Finset.univ : Finset V).filter (fun x =>
            (∀ i ∈ P, x i = pins i) ∧ (∑ i : Fin k, x i) = par ∧
            (∀ j ∈ S, (∑ i : Fin k, x i * v j i) = target j))).card = 2^k
changed.unlocks: Converts the two distance margins into exact query counts after pinning row bits and total parity.
changed.context: The coordinate tests on P and the all-ones test are independent since |P|<k. Their span consists of masks supported on P and their complements. The weight margins exclude every nonempty selected sum from this span. The enlarged linear map is onto, so all fibers have equal size. Conversely, pin the support of a near-zero sum or the zero positions of a near-one sum. With zero pins and even total parity its answer is forced. Prescribe answers with odd sum on the selected indices to get an empty fiber. A gate-floor companion cannot exist because the term counts rows.

changed.title: A syndrome transfer counts every isotropic dimension on a binary cycle with arbitrary parity checks
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (H : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) (ZMod 2)) (z : ℤ),
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin n → F
  let A := Fin m → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F A) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let used := fun h : ℕ => ∏ r ∈ Finset.range h, (z - (2 : ℤ)^r)
  let next := fun i : Fin n => (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let good := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter (fun U =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ a, (∑ i, H a i * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i))
  let col := fun (i : Fin n) (a : Fin m) => H a i
  let total : A := ∑ i : Fin n, col i
  let walk := fun D : Submodule F A =>
    let B := A ⧸ D
    letI : Fintype B := Fintype.ofFinite _
    let symbol := fun i : Fin n => D.mkQ (col i)
    let closeRun := fun b : B => if b = 0 then z-1 else -1
    let T : Fin n → Matrix (Option B) (Option B) ℤ := fun i before after =>
      before.elim (after.elim 1 (fun b => if b = symbol i then 1 else 0))
        (fun a => after.elim (closeRun a) (fun b => if b = a + symbol i then 1 else 0))
    Matrix.trace (List.ofFn T).prod + closeRun (D.mkQ total) -
      (if D.mkQ total = 0 then (Fintype.card B : ℤ) else 0)
  z^m * (∑ U ∈ good, used (Module.finrank F U)) =
    ∑ D : Submodule F A, used (m - Module.finrank F D) * walk D
changed.unlocks: Computes all isotropic subcode dimension counts with matrix size controlled by the number of check rows, independently of the length and the dimension counted.
changed.context: At z=2^j count ordered j-tuples of codewords with isotropic span, grouped by span dimension. Fourier-filter the checks. Adjacent nonzero generator columns must agree, so every occupied run has one nonzero color. Summing this color gives z-1 for zero accumulated syndrome in the quotient by the character map's kernel D, and -1 otherwise. Count character maps by kernel. Accumulate the run syndrome and reset on zeros. The all-occupied cycle needs its own weight in place of the trace's arbitrary starting syndrome. Interpolate from all j.

changed.title: Three-letter tests force the exact rational state dimension of the cyclic run transfer with empty end states
changed.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ) (z : ℚ),
  let A := Fin r → ZMod 2
  let q := 2^r
  let f := fun a : A => if a = 0 then z-1 else -1
  let T : A → Matrix (Option A) (Option A) ℚ := fun h before after =>
    before.elim (after.elim 1 (fun b => if b = h then 1 else 0))
      (fun a => after.elim (f a) (fun b => if b = a+h then 1 else 0))
  let series := fun w : List A => (w.map T).prod none none
  let fits := fun (k : ℕ) (test : List A → Prop) =>
    ∃ (left right : Fin k → ℚ) (M : A → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ),
      ∀ w : List A, test w →
        (∑ i : Fin k, ∑ j : Fin k, left i * (w.map M).prod i j * right j) = series w
  let least := if z = 0 then 2 else if z = (q : ℚ) then q else q+1
  ∀ k : ℕ, (fits k (fun w => w.length ≤ 3) ↔ least ≤ k) ∧
    (fits k (fun _ => True) ↔ least ≤ k)
changed.unlocks: Identifies exactly which parameter values permit a smaller linear representation of a syndrome run transfer with prescribed empty endpoints.
changed.context: The empty prefix row is the empty basis vector. A one-symbol prefix adds the corresponding syndrome vector, so these rows span. Empty, one- and two-symbol suffix columns span the empty vector and all translates of f=z times the zero indicator minus one. The translate matrix is zI-J. Its rank is Q generally, Q-1 at z=Q and one at z=0. This suffix space is invariant under all symbol matrices, giving a realization there. The finite prefix-suffix matrix supplies the matching lower bound, with no word longer than three.

changed.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (v u w : Fin n) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E) → ((b, c) ∈ E ∨ (c, b) ∈ E) → ((c, d) ∈ E ∨ (d, c) ∈ E) → ((d, a) ∈ E ∨ (a, d) ∈ E) → False) → u ≠ w → ((v, u) ∈ E ∨ (u, v) ∈ E) → ((v, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, v) ∈ E) → (∀ z : Fin n, ((v, z) ∈ E ∨ (z, v) ∈ E) → z = u ∨ z = w) → (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ v ∧ e.2 ≠ v) → (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ v ∧ e.2 ≠ v ∧ e.1 ≠ u ∧ e.2 ≠ u ∧ e.1 ≠ w ∧ e.2 ≠ w) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => x e.1 && x e.2)) → (∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size + 3 ≤ C.size ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => Function.update x v false e.1 && Function.update x v false e.2)) ∨ (∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size + 4 ≤ C.size ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => Function.update x v true e.1 && Function.update x v true e.2))

changed.title: One exceptional binomial tail covers every hidden output in a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit for the common-key graph
changed.statement:
∀ (k r e q : Nat), 0 < q → 4 * r + 1 ≤ k → e + q + 4 ≤ r → k + e + 3 = 5 * r →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let h := (k + 1) / 2
  let graph : Fin (2 ^ k) → Fin (2 ^ k) → Bool := fun row col =>
    (List.range (2 ^ k)).any (fun w =>
      decide (first w row.val < 2 ^ (k - h)) && decide (second w col.val < 2 ^ (k - h)))
  let T := min r ((k + 5) / 5)
  let N := T - 4
  let D := e + q - 1
  let exceptions := 2 ^ (k - N) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), Nat.choose N j)
  D < N →
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (k + k) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 256 * (k + 1) * (r + 1) *
      (2 ^ (k - q) + exceptions) ∧
    ∀ bits : Fin (k + k) → Bool,
      C.eval (List.ofFn bits) = PEqualNP.Represents.adjFun (k := k) (l := k) graph bits
changed.unlocks: Prices all exceptional keys of the hidden block as one family in the scheduled two-test circuit.
changed.context: The ordinary slot zeros the upper copy at H=k+(k-q)-2r+3. Output i=k-q+b-1 has i+3r-H=e+b-1. Use the same N guard bits for every b. If their weight exceeds e+q-1, the cut certificate gives all q pre-key outputs together, so the descending ordinary sweep recovers the passing key. Otherwise take one slot for its full trace and k-N free starting bits. Recover all N pivots in one period on one lifted grid. Check both periodic tests on each recovered key and OR. There is one exceptional family regardless of which outputs changed.

changed.title: Flipping labels on addressed triangles takes exactly b+1 adaptive parity queries or 2^b fixed ones, with exact weighted error at every fixed budget
changed.statement:
∀ b : ℕ,
  let A := Fin b → ZMod 2
  let D := A → ZMod 2 × ZMod 2
  let V := A × D
  let s := 2 ^ b
  let edge := fun z : V =>
    (if (z.2 z.1).1 = 0 then (if (z.2 z.1).2 = 0 then (0, 1) else (1, 2))
     else (2, 0) : Fin 3 × Fin 3)
  let Colors := fun q : ℕ => (Fin q → ZMod 2) → (A × Fin 3) → Bool
  let losses := fun (q : ℕ) (transcript : V → Fin q → ZMod 2) (colors : Colors q) (wt : A → ℕ) =>
    ∑ addr : A, wt addr * (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : D =>
      colors (transcript (addr, x)) (addr, (edge (addr, x)).1) =
      colors (transcript (addr, x)) (addr, (edge (addr, x)).2))).card
  let Ask := fun limit : ℕ => (j : Fin limit) → (Fin j.val → ZMod 2) → (V →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
  let follows := fun (depth : ℕ) (ask : Ask depth) (run : V → Fin depth → ZMod 2) =>
    ∀ (key : V) (j : Fin depth),
      run key j = ask j (fun i => run key ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans i.isLt j.isLt⟩) key
  (∀ (q : ℕ) (w : A → ℕ),
    let saved := ((Finset.univ : Finset A).powerset.filter (fun T => T.card ≤ q)).sup
      (fun T => ∑ j ∈ T, w j)
    let cost := 4 ^ (s - 1) * ((∑ j : A, w j) - saved)
    (∃ (Q : V →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin q → ZMod 2)) (label : Colors q), losses q Q label w = cost) ∧
    ∀ (M : V →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin q → ZMod 2)) (family : Colors q), cost ≤ losses q M family w) ∧
  ∀ h : ℕ, (∃ (ask : Ask h) (run : V → Fin h → ZMod 2) (decoder : Colors h),
    follows h ask run ∧ losses h run decoder (fun _ => 1) = 0) ↔ b + 1 ≤ h
changed.unlocks: prices fixed and adaptive parity questions for addressed output triangles, including the exact weighted error at every fixed budget
changed.context: Restrict queries to data. Unless their row space contains a nonzero form supported on block j alone, every reached fiber at address j shows all four signatures equally. Any cut misses at least one quarter. Local forms on distinct blocks are independent, so at most q blocks escape this cost. Read bit zero of each of the q heaviest blocks and use a fixed best cut elsewhere. Adaptively read b address bits and the selected data bit. Collecting all tests of a depth-h tree gives at most 2^h-1 fixed forms, forcing h at least b+1. A gate-saving companion cannot exist for a parity-query budget.

changed.title: Find a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit below the sparse four-cycle-free graph bound
changed.statement:
∃ (n m d : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (edge : Bool)
    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  let nbrR := fun (a : Fin n) => Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin m => G a v = edge)
  let nbrC := fun (c : Fin m) => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G u c = edge)
  2 ≤ d ∧
  (∀ a, 2 ≤ (nbrR a).card ∧ (nbrR a).card ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ c, 2 ≤ (nbrC c).card ∧ (nbrC c).card ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ a b, a ≠ b → ((nbrR a) ∩ (nbrR b)).card ≤ 1) ∧
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C ∧
  (48 * d + 1) * C.size + 150 * d + 5 < (48 * d + 2) * (n + m)
changed.unlocks: tests the stated size bound for binary circuits on sparse graphs of either polarity

changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>

  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit finds whether q parity answers make all selected one-round probes affine and counts the passing keys when they do
changed.statement:
∀ (k m t q : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k),
  let K := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → K
  let X := Fin m → K
  let ix := fun pos : ℕ => (⟨pos % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (j : Fin k) => w (ix (j.val+k-s%k))
  let mixed := fun (d s : ℕ) (w name : W) =>
    let z := rot s w + name
    fun mid : Fin k => z mid + z (ix (mid.val+d)) + z (ix (mid.val+k-d%k))
  ∀ (site : Fin t → Fin k) (col : Fin t → Bool),
    let spacing := fun spacingId => if col spacingId then 2 else 1
    let start := fun startId => if col startId then 3 else 1
    let injectAt := fun injectId => if col injectId then 4 else 0
    let inputs := (m+5)*k+t
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (inputs+C.size))
      (out : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
      C.size ≤ 2^20*(k+m+t+2)^8*3^(min q (min m t)) ∧
      ∀ (base : W) (gen : Fin m → W) (u v cr cc : W) (wanted : Fin t → K),
        let key := fun x : X => base + ∑ g : Fin m, x g • gen g
        let probe := fun (raw : W) (idx : Fin t) =>
          let y := mixed (spacing idx) (start idx) raw (if col idx then v else u)
          let j := site idx
          y j + (1+y (ix (j.val+1))) * y (ix (j.val+2)) +
            rot (injectAt idx) raw j + (if col idx then cc j else cr j)
        let operand := fun (p : Fin t) (offset : ℕ) (g : Fin m) =>
          mixed (spacing p) (start p) (gen g) 0 (ix ((site p).val+offset))
        let hits := ∃ basis : Fin q → X,
          let D := Submodule.span K (Set.range basis)
          ∀ j, operand j 1 ∈ D ∨ operand j 2 ∈ D ∨ operand j 1 + operand j 2 ∈ D
        let flat := ∃ U : Submodule K X, m ≤ Module.finrank K U + q ∧
          ∀ (z : X) (p : Fin t), ∃ (ell : X →ₗ[K] K) (c : K),
            ∀ x ∈ U, probe (key (z+x)) p = ell x + c
        let pack := fun word : W => List.ofFn (fun bit : Fin k => decide (word bit ≠ 0))
        let bits := pack base ++ (List.ofFn (fun h => pack (gen h))).flatten ++
          pack u ++ pack v ++ pack cr ++ pack cc ++ List.ofFn (fun targetId => decide (wanted targetId ≠ 0))
        (hits ↔ flat) ∧ ((C.wires bits).getD flag.val false = true ↔ hits) ∧
        (hits →
          let count := Nat.card { raw : W // raw ∈ Set.range key ∧ ∀ p, probe raw p = wanted p }
          ∀ o : Fin (k+1), (C.wires bits).getD (out o).val false = count.testBit o.val)

Choose one successful basis before doing any counting. On each binary answer cell combine the parity equations with the now affine probes, eliminate, sum the fiber sizes, and divide by the generator kernel size.

changed.statement:
∀ (k m t r q : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k),
  let W := Fin k → ZMod 2
  let ix := fun index : ℕ => (⟨index%k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let shift := fun (inputPos : Fin k) (s : ℕ) => ix (inputPos.val+k-s%k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (word : W) (pos : Fin k) => word (shift pos s)
  ∀ (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (site : Fin t → Fin k)
    (column : Fin t → Bool) (time : Fin t → Fin (r+1)),
    let delay := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 2 else 1
    let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
    let feed := fun (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) => if b then 3*(i+1)+1 else 2*i
    let deps := fun (b : Bool) (i : Fin r) (old : Fin k → Finset (Fin k)) =>
      let mix := fun mid : Fin k =>
        old mid ∪ old (ix (mid.val+delay b)) ∪ old (shift mid (delay b))
      fun dest : Fin k =>
        insert (shift dest (feed b i.val)) (mix dest ∪ mix (ix (dest.val+1)) ∪ mix (ix (dest.val+2)))
    let scope := fun obs : Fin t =>
      (((List.finRange r).take (time obs).val).foldl
        (fun prior tick => deps (column obs) tick prior)
        (fun rawSite : Fin k => {shift rawSite (start (column obs))})) (site obs)
    let inputs := (m+3+2*r)*k+t
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (out : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),

      C.size ≤ 2^20 * (k+m+t+r+2)^9 * 2^(min q k) ∧

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit counts matching cyclic keys using seven products per dimension of three independent translation spaces
changed.statement:
∀ (k m t r g h : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), 3*h ≤ g → g ≤ min k m →
  let W := Fin k → ZMod 2
  let ix := fun index : ℕ => (⟨index%k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let shift := fun (inputPos : Fin k) (s : ℕ) => ix (inputPos.val+k-s%k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (word : W) (pos : Fin k) => word (shift pos s)
  ∀ (site : Fin t → Fin k)
    (column : Fin t → Bool) (time : Fin t → Fin (r+1)) (owner : Fin t → Fin 3),
    let delay := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 2 else 1
    let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
    let feed := fun (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) => if b then 3*(i+1)+1 else 2*i
    let deps := fun (b : Bool) (i : Fin r) (old : Fin k → Finset (Fin k)) =>
      let mix := fun mid : Fin k =>
        old mid ∪ old (ix (mid.val+delay b)) ∪ old (shift mid (delay b))
      fun dest : Fin k =>
        insert (shift dest (feed b i.val)) (mix dest ∪ mix (ix (dest.val+1)) ∪ mix (ix (dest.val+2)))
    let scope : Fin t → Finset (Fin k) := fun obs : Fin t =>
      (((List.finRange r).take (time obs).val).foldl
        (fun prior tick => deps (column obs) tick prior)
        (fun rawSite : Fin k => {shift rawSite (start (column obs))})) (site obs)
    let inputs := (m+3+2*r)*k+t
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (inputs+C.size))
        (out : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
      C.size ≤ 2^44 * (k+m+t+r+3)^12 * 2^(g-3*h) * 7^h ∧
      ∀ (base : W) (gen : Fin m → W) (u v : W) (cr cc : Fin r → W)
        (target : Fin t → ZMod 2),
        let delta := fun coeff : Fin m → ZMod 2 => ∑ gi : Fin m, coeff gi • gen gi
        let key := fun params : Fin m → ZMod 2 => base + delta params
        let M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) (ZMod 2) := gen
        let run := fun (b : Bool) (w : W) (n : ℕ) =>
          ((List.finRange r).take n).foldl (fun z tick =>
            let mix := fun midPos : Fin k =>
              z midPos + z (ix (midPos.val+delay b)) + z (shift midPos (delay b))
            fun j : Fin k =>
              mix j + (1+mix (ix (j.val+1)))*mix (ix (j.val+2)) +
              rot (feed b tick.val) w j + (if b then cc tick else cr tick) j)
            (rot (start b) w + (if b then v else u))
        let pack := fun inputWord : W => List.ofFn (fun bit : Fin k => decide (inputWord bit ≠ 0))
        let bits := pack base ++ (List.ofFn (fun gi => pack (gen gi))).flatten ++
          pack u ++ pack v ++ (List.ofFn (fun ri => pack (cr ri))).flatten ++
          (List.ofFn (fun ci => pack (cc ci))).flatten ++ List.ofFn (fun obsIdx => decide (target obsIdx ≠ 0))
        let probe := fun (word : W) (obsIdx : Fin t) =>
          run (column obsIdx) word (time obsIdx).val (site obsIdx)
        let admissible := ∃ dirs : (Fin 3 × Fin h) → W,
          LinearIndependent (ZMod 2) dirs ∧ (∀ s, dirs s ∈ Set.range delta) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin t) (s : Fin h),

            else ∀ pos ∈ scope j, dirs (owner j,s) pos = 0

changed.title: Overlapping triples of row outputs and quintuples of column outputs have an exact fixed parity query cost on the shared key
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
  let I := ZMod k
  let B := ZMod 2
  let V := I → B
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : V) (i : I) => w (i-(s : I))
  let mix := fun (d : ℕ) (w : V) (i : I) => w (i-(d : I))+w i+w (i+(d : I))
  let out := fun (d u v : ℕ) (name c x : V) (j : I) =>
    let y := mix d (rot u x + name)
    y j + (1+y (j+1))*y (j+2) + rot v x j + c j
  let patch := fun (starts : Finset I) (left len : ℕ) =>
    starts.biUnion (fun p => (Finset.range len).image (fun t : ℕ => p-(left : I)+(t : I)))
  ∀ (row col cr cc : V) (R C : Finset I),
    let S := patch R 0 3
    let T := patch C 0 5
    let sites := patch R 2 7 ∪ patch C 5 11
    let need := if sites = ∅ ∨ k = 1 then 0 else if k = 3 then 2 else sites.card
    ∀ q : ℕ,
      (∃ (forms : Fin q → V) (decode : (Fin q → B) → V × V),
        ∀ key : V,
          let ans := decode (fun t => dotProduct (forms t) key)
          (∀ j ∈ S, ans.1 j = out 1 1 0 row cr key j) ∧
          (∀ i ∈ T, ans.2 i = out 2 3 4 col cc key i)) ↔ need ≤ q

changed.context: Translate a block start to zero. Three row tests force bits -2 through 1 of a period equal. A(1) through A(6) vanish and A(j)=z(j-4) for j=0..4. This kills -3 through 0, then -4,-5 and 1 through 5. Take the union modulo k. A correct parity map has kernel inside these periods. changed.title: Output quotients give a fan-in-two circuit counting distinct affine keys matching degree-bounded cyclic probes across rounds
changed.statement:
∀ (k m t r g h d : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), h ≤ g → g ≤ min k m →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let Y := Fin t → F
  let low := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin g) => S.card ≤ d)
  let W := Fin k → ZMod 2
  let ix := fun index : ℕ => (⟨index%k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let shift := fun (inputPos : Fin k) (s : ℕ) => ix (inputPos.val+k-s%k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (word : W) (pos : Fin k) => word (shift pos s)
  ∀ (site : Fin t → Fin k)
    (column : Fin t → Bool) (time : Fin t → Fin (r+1)),
    let delay := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 2 else 1
    let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
    let feed := fun (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) => if b then 3*(i+1)+1 else 2*i
    let inputs := (m+3+2*r)*k+t
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (inputs+C.size))
        (out : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
      C.size ≤ 2^44 * (k+m+t+r+3)^14 * (low.card + 2^(g-h)) ∧
      ∀ (base : W) (gen : Fin m → W) (u v : W) (cr cc : Fin r → W) (target : Y),
        let D := Submodule.span F (Set.range gen)
        let raw := fun a : Fin m → F => base + ∑ i : Fin m, a i • gen i
        let run := fun (b : Bool) (w : W) (n : ℕ) =>
          ((List.finRange r).take n).foldl (fun z tick =>
            let mix := fun midPos : Fin k =>
              z midPos + z (ix (midPos.val+delay b)) + z (shift midPos (delay b))
            fun j : Fin k =>
              mix j + (1+mix (ix (j.val+1)))*mix (ix (j.val+2)) +
              rot (feed b tick.val) w j + (if b then cc tick else cr tick) j)
            (rot (start b) w + (if b then v else u))
        let pack := fun inputWord : W => List.ofFn (fun bit : Fin k => decide (inputWord bit ≠ 0))
        let bits := pack base ++ (List.ofFn (fun gi => pack (gen gi))).flatten ++
          pack u ++ pack v ++ (List.ofFn (fun ri => pack (cr ri))).flatten ++
          (List.ofFn (fun ci => pack (cc ci))).flatten ++ List.ofFn (fun obsIdx => decide (target obsIdx ≠ 0))
        let probe := fun (word : W) (obsIdx : Fin t) =>
          run (column obsIdx) word (time obsIdx).val (site obsIdx)
        let eval := fun x : D => probe (base+x.val)
        let dirs := fun H : Submodule F Y =>
          {v' : D | ∀ x : D, (eval (x+v') - eval x) - (eval v' - eval 0) ∈ H}
        let grow := fun prior : Submodule F Y =>
          prior ⊔ Submodule.span F ((fun stepVec : D => eval stepVec - eval 0) '' dirs prior)
        let finalSpace := (grow^[t]) (⊥ : Submodule F Y)
        let wire := fun address : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD address.val false
        Module.finrank F D = g →
        (∀ probeIdx : Fin t, ∃ c : Finset (Fin m) → F, ∀ a : Fin m → F,
          probe (raw a) probeIdx =
            ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => T.card ≤ d), c S * ∏ i ∈ S, a i) →
        (wire flag = true ↔ 2^h ≤ Nat.card ↥(dirs finalSpace)) ∧
        (wire flag = true →
          let count := Nat.card {x : D // eval x = target}
          ∀ o : Fin (k+1), wire (out o) = count.testBit o.val)

changed.title: Ordinary matrix transfers of two cyclic words recover the exact joint Walsh sums and key counts through the common reinjection schedule
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (r : ℕ),
  let I := ZMod k
  let B := ZMod 2
  let V := I → B
  let N := (2:ℤ)^k
  let sign := fun (t : B) => if t = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else -1
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (word : V) (i : I) => word (i-(s : I))
  let back := fun (s : ℕ) (b : V) (i : I) => b (i+(s : I))
  let mix := fun (d : ℕ) (x : V) (i : I) => x (i-(d : I)) + x i + x (i+(d : I))
  let nl := fun (y : V) (j : I) => y j + (1+y (j+1))*y (j+2)
  let kernel := fun (d : ℕ) (a b : V) =>
    ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun v : V => mix d v = a),
      Matrix.trace (List.prod (α := Matrix B B ℤ) ((List.range k).map (fun j =>
        let i := (j : I)
        (fun (l h : B) => sign ((u i+b i+b (i-2))*l+b (i-1)*l*h) : Matrix B B ℤ))))
  ∀ (row col : V) (C : ℕ → V),
    let orbit := fun (key : V) =>
      (List.range r).foldl (fun (st : V × V) tick =>
        (nl (mix 1 st.1) + rot (2*tick) key + C (tick+1),
         nl (mix 2 st.2) + rot (3*(tick+1)+1) key + C (r+tick+1)))
        (rot 1 key + row, rot 3 key + col)
    let initial := fun (a b q : V) =>
      if q + back 1 a + back 3 b = 0 then N*sign (dotProduct a row + dotProduct b col) else 0
    let H := (List.range r).foldl (fun (old : V → V → V → ℤ) roundIndex p s t =>
      sign (dotProduct p (C (roundIndex+1)) + dotProduct s (C (r+roundIndex+1))) *
        ∑ a : V, ∑ b : V, kernel 1 a p * kernel 2 b s *
          old a b (t + back (2*roundIndex) p + back (3*(roundIndex+1)+1) s)) initial
    (∀ a b q : V, H a b q = N^(2*r) *
      ∑ w : V, sign (dotProduct a (orbit w).1 + dotProduct b (orbit w).2 + dotProduct q w)) ∧
    ∀ (S T : Finset I) (y z : V),
      let supported := fun (sites : Finset I) => Finset.univ.filter (fun mask : V =>
        ∀ i : I, i ∉ sites → mask i = 0)
      let passing := Finset.univ.filter (fun w : V =>
        (∀ i ∈ S, (orbit w).1 i = y i) ∧ (∀ j ∈ T, (orbit w).2 j = z j))
      (∑ a ∈ supported S, ∑ b ∈ supported T,
        sign (dotProduct a y + dotProduct b z) * H a b 0) =
        N^(2*r) * (2:ℤ)^(S.card+T.card) * (passing.card : ℤ)

Rotation moves each injection mask back to the same raw-key frequency. Induct on the round count and track the two inversion factors N per round. Character orthogonality on the selected output positions gives the final key count. At width two and zero masks the one-round scaled joint moment is 64.

changed.title: Conditional sign-matrix rank and rigidity from triangular Walsh support and coefficient formulas
changed.statement:
let triangularSupport : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℕ,
    let V := Fin t → ZMod 2
    ∀ (A B : Fin t → Fin t → ZMod 2) (γ : V),
      let sources := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin t)).filter (fun j =>
        ∃ i, j < i ∧ (A i j ≠ 0 ∨ B i j ≠ 0))
      let c := fun (j : Fin t) (z : V × V) =>
        γ j + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioi j, (z.1 i * A i j + z.2 i * B i j)
      let live := (Finset.univ : Finset (V × V)).filter (fun z =>
        ∀ j, c j z ≠ 0 ∨ (z.1 j = 0 ∧ z.2 j = 0))
      let lhs := 2 * 4^sources.card * live.card
      let rhs := (4^sources.card + 1) * 4^t
      lhs ≤ rhs ∧
        (lhs = rhs ↔
          (∀ j, j ∉ sources → γ j = 1) ∧
          ∀ j ∈ sources, ∀ k ∈ sources, ∀ z, c j z = c k z)
let coefficientProduct : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℕ,
    let V := Fin s → ZMod 2
    let dot := fun (u v : V) => ∑ i : Fin s, u i * v i
    let sign := fun (x : ZMod 2) => if x = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else -1
    ∀ (A B : Fin s → Fin s → ZMod 2) (γ : V) (Z : V → V → V),
    (∀ x y i, Z x y i =
      (x i + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iio i, A i j * Z x y j) *
      (y i + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iio i, B i j * Z x y j)) →
    ∀ p q : V,
      let c := fun (j : Fin s) =>
        γ j + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioi j, (p i * A i j + q i * B i j)
      (∑ x : V, ∑ y : V, sign (dot γ (Z x y) + dot p x + dot q y)) =
        ∏ j : Fin s,
          if c j = 0 then (if p j = 0 ∧ q j = 0 then 4 else 0)
          else 2 * sign (p j * q j)
let conclusion : Prop :=
  let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
    (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false,false]) (g.op.eval [false,true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true,false]) (g.op.eval [true,true]))
  ∀ (n m : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) →
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) C →
    let t := C.gates.countP nonlinear
    let raw := Fin (n+m) → Bool
    let W := fun (w : ℕ) (x : raw) => (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD w false
    let defect : Matrix (Fin (n+m+C.gates.length)) (raw × raw) (ZMod 2) := fun w v =>
      if (∃ g ∈ C.gates, nonlinear g = true ∧ w.val ∈ g.inputs) ∧
        xor (xor (W w.val v.1) (W w.val v.2))
            (xor (W w.val (fun i => xor (v.1 i) (v.2 i))) (W w.val (fun _ => false))) = true
      then 1 else 0
    let value := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach a b)
    let K : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℚ := fun i j => if value i j then -1 else 1
    let V := Fin (2*t) → ZMod 2
    2 * 4^defect.rank * K.rank ≤ (4^defect.rank + 1) * 4^t ∧
    (5 * 4^t < 8 * K.rank → defect.rank = 0 ∧
      ∃ (row : Fin n → V) (col : Fin m → V) (Q : Fin n → Bool) (R : Fin m → Bool),
        ∀ i j, value i j = xor (xor (Q i) (R j))
          (decide ((∑ b : Fin (2*t), row i b * col j b) = 1)))
triangularSupport → coefficientProduct → conclusion

changed.title: A fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit on 2h name parities returns the normalized one-round common-key count in at most 4096(h+1) gates
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (h : ℕ), 5 ≤ h → h + 7 ≤ k →
  let I := ZMod k
  let W := I → ZMod 2
  let lo := k - h
  let turn := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) => word (site - (dist : I))
  let mix := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word (site - (dist : I)) + word site + word (site + (dist : I))
  let chi := fun (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word site + (1 + word (site+1)) * word (site+2)
  let tested := fun site : I => lo ≤ site.val
  ∀ (rowConst colConst : W),
    let good := fun (u v key : W) =>
      let row := chi (mix 1 (turn 1 key + u)) + key + rowConst

changed.title: Disjoint perfect matchings on the actual cyclic name graph account for every common-key multiplicity
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (h r : ℕ),
  let span := if r = 1 then 7 else 7*r-2
  let seed := if r = 1 then 4 else 6*r-5
  (r = 1 ∨ 4 ≤ r) → max 5 (r+3) ≤ h → h+span ≤ k →
  let I := ZMod k
  let W := I → ZMod 2
  let lo := k-h
  let turn := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) => word (site - (dist : I))
  let mix := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word (site - (dist : I)) + word site + word (site + (dist : I))
  let chi := fun (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word site + (1 + word (site+1)) * word (site+2)
  ∀ cr cc : ℕ → W,
    let rowTest := fun (u key : W) =>
      let out := (List.range r).foldl (fun acc t =>
        chi (mix 1 acc) + turn (2*t) key + cr (t+1)) (turn 1 key + u)
      ∀ i : I, lo ≤ i.val → out i = 0
    let colTest := fun (v key : W) =>
      let out := (List.range r).foldl (fun acc t =>
        chi (mix 2 acc) + turn (3*(t+1)+1) key + cc (t+1)) (turn 3 key + v)
      ∀ i : I, lo ≤ i.val → out i = 0
    let wt := fun (u v : W) => Nat.card {x : W // rowTest u x ∧ colTest v x}
    let layers := 2^seed
    let degree := 2^(lo+span-seed)
    ∃ perm : Fin layers → Fin degree → Equiv.Perm W,
      (∀ j u, Function.Injective (fun t => perm j t u)) ∧
      ∀ u v, wt u v = 2^(lo-span) *
        (Nat.card {p : Fin layers × Fin degree // perm p.1 p.2 u = v})

Equality of entry counts supplies every multiplicity and excludes nonedges.

changed.title: Three observed cyclic differences limit the raw key to eight or sixteen candidates across all names
changed.statement:
∀ (k d : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), 11 ≤ k → Odd k → k % 3 ≠ 0 → (d = 1 ∨ d = 2) →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun (n : ℕ) => (⟨n % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (n : ℕ) (x : W) (i : Fin k) => x (ix (i.val+k-n%k))
  let mix := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    x i + x (ix (i.val+d)) + x (ix (i.val+k-d%k))
  let layer := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    mix x i + (1+mix x (ix (i.val+1)))*mix x (ix (i.val+2))
  ∀ (start : ℕ) (feed : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℕ → W),
    let state := fun (sched : ℕ → W) (name key : W) (t : ℕ) =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => W) (rot start key + name) (fun j x => layer x + rot (feed j) key + sched j) t
    let ones : W := fun _ => 1
    let hole := fun (i j : Fin k) => if j = i then (0 : F) else 1
    let diff := fun (nm w v : W) (j : ℕ) => state c nm (w+v) j - state c nm w j
    let pairs := fun (t : ℕ) (v : W) (i : Fin k) (z : W) =>
      (Finset.univ : Finset (W × W)).filter (fun nw =>
        diff nw.1 nw.2 v t = ones ∧ diff nw.1 nw.2 v (t+1) = hole i ∧
        diff nw.1 nw.2 v (t+2) = z)
    let free : ℕ := if d = 1 then 2 else 3
    let cap : ℕ := 2^(free+1)
    (∀ t v i z, ((pairs t v i z).image Prod.snd).card ≤ cap) ∧
    (∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun z => (pairs 0 ones i z).Nonempty)).card = 2^(k-free) ∧
      ∀ z, (pairs 0 ones i z).Nonempty →
        (pairs 0 ones i z).card = cap ∧ ((pairs 0 ones i z).image Prod.snd).card = cap)

At spacing one they form one run. Its middle site is free and the ones share one bit. At spacing two they are isolated and pinned, leaving three runs of ones. In the initial window an even-weight hole is attainable. The two updated bases differ by the missing unit. This unit lies outside the next kernel since the hole lies inside and all ones pairs nontrivially with its nonconstant mix.

changed.title: Disjoint cyclic windows give exact products of five and three for prescribed key outputs and exact row-name counts
changed.statement:
∀ (k : Nat), 0 < k → ∀ constant : Nat → Fin (2 ^ k),
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc cell =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit cell)
        (!(word.testBit ((cell + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((cell + 2) % k))).toNat <<< cell)) 0
  let state := fun (row rounds key : Nat) =>
    (List.range rounds).foldl (fun prev tick =>
      step (prev ^^^ rot 1 prev ^^^ rot (k - 1) prev) ^^^ rot (2 * tick) key ^^^
        (constant (tick + 1)).val) (rot 1 key ^^^ row)
  let injected := fun (round key pos : Nat) =>
    xor ((rot (2 * (round - 1)) key).testBit (pos % k))
      ((constant round).val.testBit (pos % k))
  let bit := fun (row round key pos : Nat) => (state row round key).testBit (pos % k)
  ∀ (m : Nat) (starts : Fin m → Nat),
  Function.Injective (fun z : Fin m × Fin 12 => (starts z.1+z.2.val) % k) →
  let good := fun (row ref : Fin (2^k)) (p : Nat) =>
    let old := fun (j : Nat) => bit row.val 0 ref.val (p+j)
    let first := fun (j : Nat) => bit row.val 1 ref.val (p+j)
    let τ := xor (xor (old 6) (old 7)) (old 8)
    let α := xor (xor (xor (old 5) (old 6)) (old 7)) (injected 1 ref.val (p+6))
    let β := xor τ (injected 1 ref.val (p+7))
    τ = false ∧ xor (xor (first 3) (first 4)) (first 5) = true ∧
      xor (first 4) (first 5) = !α ∧ first 4 = β
  let maj := fun (ref : Fin (2^k)) (p : Nat) => !(injected 2 ref.val (p+5))
  (∀ (row ref : Fin (2^k)), (∀ i, good row ref (starts i)) →
    ∀ pin : Finset (Fin k),
    (∀ i (j : Fin 9), ∃ z ∈ pin, z.val = (starts i+j.val) % k) →
    (∀ i (j : Fin 3), ∀ z ∈ pin, z.val ≠ (starts i+9+j.val) % k) →
    ∀ target : Fin m → Bool,
    let h := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => target i == maj ref (starts i))).card
    let keys := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2^k))).filter (fun q =>
      (∀ z ∈ pin, bit row.val 0 q.val z.val = bit row.val 0 ref.val z.val) ∧
      ∀ i, bit row.val 2 q.val (starts i+5) = target i)
    keys.card = 2^(k-pin.card-3*m) * 5^h * 3^(m-h)) ∧
  (∀ anchor : Fin (2^k),
    let refOf := fun (row : Fin (2^k)) =>
      (⟨(rot (k-1) (row.val ^^^ anchor.val)) % (2^k), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.two_pow_pos k)⟩ : Fin (2^k))
    (∀ row : Fin (2^k), state row.val 0 (refOf row).val = anchor.val) ∧
    ((∀ i, let p := starts i
      xor (xor (anchor.val.testBit ((p+6) % k)) (anchor.val.testBit ((p+7) % k)))
        (anchor.val.testBit ((p+8) % k)) = false) →
      ∀ orient : Fin m → Option Bool,
      let prescribed := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (orient i).isSome)).card
      let rows := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2^k))).filter (fun row =>
        ∀ i, good row (refOf row) (starts i) ∧
          ∀ b : Bool, orient i = some b → maj (refOf row) (starts i) = b)
      rows.card = 2^(k-3*m-prescribed)))

let F := ZMod 2
∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Algebra F K] [FiniteDimensional F K]
    (k : ℕ) (basis : Module.Basis (Fin k) F K) (bit : K →ₗ[F] F), bit ≠ 0 →
  let n := k+1
  let point : Fin n → K := Fin.cases 0 basis
  let mult := fun (z : K) (x y : Fin n) => decide (bit (z * point x * point y) ≠ 0)
  let residual := fun {g : ℕ} (T : Fin g → Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (S : Finset (Fin g))
      (z : K) (x y : Fin n) => xor (mult z x y) (((S.filter (fun i => T i x y)).card % 2) == 1)

  k % 2 = 1 → ∀ (a b : ℕ), 0 < a → 0 < b → k ≤ a*b →
    let g := a+b-1
    ∃ d : Fin g → K,
      let T := fun (i : Fin g) (x y : Fin n) =>
        decide (bit (d i * point x) ≠ 0) && decide (bit (d i * point y) ≠ 0)
      fits n n g T g ∧ ∀ z : K, z ≠ 0 →
        ∃ S : Finset (Fin g), S.card ≤ 2 ∧ fits n n 1 (fun _ => residual T S z) (k/2)

changed.title: Find jointly prepared field taps covering every multiplier below the proposed common gate budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let fits := fun (n m q : ℕ) (G : Fin q → Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (t : ℕ) =>
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (tap : Fin q → ℕ),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) C ∧
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t ∧
    ∀ j : Fin q, (depths (n+m) C).getD (tap j) 0 ≤ 1 ∧
      PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (G j) ⟨C.gates, tap j⟩

let F := ZMod 2
∃ (k s g : ℕ), 3 ≤ s ∧ k % 2 = 1 ∧ s*(2*s+1) < k ∧
  ∃ (basis : Module.Basis (Fin k) F (GaloisField 2 k))
    (bit : GaloisField 2 k →ₗ[F] F), bit ≠ 0 ∧
  let n := k+1
  let point : Fin n → GaloisField 2 k := Fin.cases 0 basis
  let mult := fun (z : GaloisField 2 k) (x y : Fin n) => decide (bit (z * point x * point y) ≠ 0)
  let residual := fun {g : ℕ} (T : Fin g → Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (S : Finset (Fin g))
      (z : GaloisField 2 k) (x y : Fin n) => xor (mult z x y) (((S.filter (fun i => T i x y)).card % 2) == 1)

  ∃ T : Fin g → Fin n → Fin n → Bool, fits n n g T s ∧
    ∀ z : GaloisField 2 k, z ≠ 0 →
      ∃ S : Finset (Fin g), fits n n 1 (fun _ => residual T S z) (k/2)

changed.title: Perfect matching on a 3 by 3 graph: some normal-form circuit of at most 11 gates opens with AND of wires 0 and 1, then AND of wires 0 and 2
changed.statement:
∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 11 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 4 && x 8) || (x 0 && x 5 && x 7) || (x 1 && x 3 && x 8) || (x 1 && x 5 && x 6) || (x 2 && x 3 && x 7) || (x 2 && x 4 && x 6))) ∧
    C.output + 1 = 9 + C.size ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧
          ∃ a, a < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a]) ∨
      (((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
          (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
          ∃ a b, a < b ∧ b < 9 + j.val ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b])) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length,
      (∃ x y : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn y)).getD (9 + j.val) false) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 9 + j.val → ∃ x : Fin 9 → Bool,
        (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (9 + j.val) false ≠ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD k false) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, j.val + 1 < C.gates.length →
      ∃ k : Fin C.gates.length, j.val < k.val ∧ 9 + j.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs) ∧
    C.gates.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [0, 1]⟩ ∧
    C.gates.tail.head? = some ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [0, 2]⟩
changed.unlocks: One case of the cut of 3 by 3 perfect matching at 11 gates by its two earliest gates: with the other cases under the same earliest gate and their cover, the floor for that earliest gate, one of five the assembly takes.
changed.sketch: The two earliest gates are written out and the circuit is in normal form: output last, operands increasing, no constant or repeated wire, every gate but the last listed later. For the no side these are hypotheses: split on the third gate, or write the normal-form gate lists of at most 11 gates with these two gates as clauses and replay a solver certificate inside Lean (the checker takes no native_decide). For the some side: one explicit gate list, each clause by decide over the 512 inputs. Too large for one file? Hand it back and it is cut again by its next gate.
